risks.title: Mineral resource and reserve estimation
risks.score_rationale: This risk is inherent to aggregate extraction operations. Mineral resource estimates may be inaccurate due to unforeseen geological circumstances, which could impact asset valuation and long-term planning.

risks.title: Dependence on operating permits
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on federal, state, and local permits for its quarry operations and extraction activities. Obtaining and maintaining these permits are critical. Any regulatory changes or difficulties in permit renewal represent a major risk to operations.

risks.title: Tightening of access to aggregate reserves
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions that stricter regulations and the finite nature of properties containing adequate aggregate reserves make it increasingly difficult and costly to secure reserves. An increasingly difficult permitting process could have a material negative effect on the business.

risks.title: Volatility in construction materials prices
risks.score_rationale: While the document indicates that aggregate prices tend to remain similar over long periods and are used for price estimation in a range of 5 to 40 dollars per ton, prices are reassessed annually. Potential volatility is moderate compared to other commodities.

risks.title: Complexity of construction operations and claims resolution
risks.score_rationale: As a major infrastructure contractor, the company is subject to inherent complexities in construction work, including claims resolution, contractual retentions, and project progress variations. These factors can significantly impact operating cash flows.

risks.title: Concentration of bonding obligation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company must provide various types of performance bonds for public and private contracts. With approximately 3.9 billion dollars of its 7.0 billion dollar CAP under bond, inability to maintain bond availability could impair the capacity to bid on projects.

ai_positioning.summary: GVA does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its annual report. There is no indication of AI use in its operations or intent to develop AI-related products.
